problem:
By changing the order of integration, find the missing limits in the following repeated integral.

$$
{\int }_{-1}^{0}{\int }_{(x+1)^{3}}^{2-{x}^{2}}{\int }_{x+z}^{z+2}\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z\,\text{d}x={\int }_{0}^{p}{\int }_{q}^{\sqrt[3]{z}-1}{\int }_{x+z}^{z+2}\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}z+{\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{r}^{0}{\int }_{x+z}^{z+2}\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}z
$$

activity_context.topic_title: Changing the Order of Integration in Triple Integrals: Changing Projection
